title: Dreams based on Video Games
content: I just discovered this sub and im so shook that we all have such similar dreams. I was curious to see how many of you also have a heavy influence from video games on your dreams? A lot of the time the world my mall hub is in seems like its based off of Sunset Valley in ts3, and also Los Santos from GTA V, with settings from my real life sprinkled around aswell. A lot of the time i can fly like im in minecraft creative mode, one dream i had i was just flying for hours, generating these amazing landscapes and cities and bizzare structures in my mind, as if i was flying over a real minecraft world that just kept generating infront of me as i flew. Many times i can fly so high that i reach the limit of the atmosphere and then the world below me dissapears and i free fall into the void like ive left a video game map. I have a secondary setting in my dreams that is sort of a separate realm thats mostly populated by animals, the world itself looks line minecraft and you can interact with the blocks and obects around you like you would in MC,if i am still a person in this setting, i try to live in this big treehouse but it always gets raided and i have to take these railroad tracks to the jungle and live there, of im an animal in this world its normall a viva pinata animal, and i have to try and escape being eaten by predators. Other times the world will mostly be populated by dinosaurs and dragons (ARK) and i will be a pterodactyl most of the time in that setting, or a mosasaur if i land in the ocean when i free fall into the animal world. The dinosaur version is like an island with a big mountain in the middle thats disproportionately tall. Its not a huge island, you can walk across it in like 10 minutes, its surrounded by the ocean. Ive been playing video games all my life so it makes sense they would impact my dreams, what games impact your dreams?
